abstract.p: Conversations often adhere to well-understood social norms that vary across cultures. For example, while addressing work superiors by their first name is commonplace in the Western culture, it is rare in Asian cultures. Adherence or violation of such norms often dictates the tenor of conversations. Humans are able to navigate social situations requiring cultural awareness quite adeptly. However, it is a hard task for NLP models.
